queries: WITH t AS (SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) AS tot FROM income WHERE link_to_member IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_member), s AS (SELECT link_to_member, tot, tot * 1.0 / SUM(tot) OVER () AS share FROM t), a AS (SELECT link_to_member, tot, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(tot) AS combined_amount, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_average_share FROM a WHERE share > avg_share;

responses.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) AS tot FROM income WHERE link_to_member IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_member), s AS (SELECT link_to_member, tot, tot * 1.0 / SUM(tot) OVER () AS share FROM t), a AS (SELECT link_to_member, tot, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(tot) AS combined_amount, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_average_share FROM a WHERE share > avg_share;

assumptions.assumption: Income rows with a NULL link_to_member are excluded, so they are not treated as a member and do not count toward the sum of all totals.
The average share is taken across all members who have income, which equals 1 divided by the number of members. 'Their average share' is the average share of the members above that threshold only.
The average excess is the mean of (member share minus the overall average share) over the members above the threshold.

assumptions.assumption: Income rows with a NULL link_to_member are excluded, so they form no member group and do not count toward the sum of all totals.
The 'average share' used as the threshold is the mean of the per-member shares across all members with income, which equals 1 divided by the number of members.
The output column 'their average share' is the mean share among only the above-average members. The excess column is the mean of (share minus the overall average share) among those same members.

assumptions.assumption: Income rows with a NULL link_to_member are excluded, so they are not a 'member' group and not part of the sum of all totals or the average share.

The average share is the mean of the per-member shares across all members with income (not only those above average). The output's 'average share' and 'average excess' are computed over the above-average members only.
